candidates.premise: A cat's food-begging purr hides a cry tuned to human ears.
candidates.key_fact: Solicitation purrs embed a high-frequency cry; listeners rated them more urgent and less pleasant (McComb et al., Current Biology, 2009).
candidates.why_care: Every cat owner has been woken by it.

candidates.premise: How a 4 kg animal makes a 25 Hz sound.
candidates.key_fact: Excised cat larynges purred at ~25–30 Hz without neural input; connective-tissue pads in the vocal folds help (Herbst et al., Current Biology, 2023).

research.pick_reason: Combine both: open on the hidden cry (strong hook), explain the mechanism, pay off with the request.

script.title: Your Cat's Purr Is Hiding a Cry
script.hook: Your cat's purr hides a cry you can't ignore.

beats.text: Your cat's purr hides a cry you can't ignore.
Purring is a deep rumble, as low as twenty-five hertz, made in the voice box.
In 2023, researchers in Vienna found tiny pads inside cats' vocal folds that let such a small animal hum that low.
And when your cat wants breakfast, it slips a high, baby-like cry into the purr.
Listeners rate that purr as more urgent.
So that rumble isn't only contentment. Sometimes, it's a request.

script.full_text: Your cat's purr hides a cry you can't ignore. Purring is a deep rumble, as low as twenty-five hertz, made in the voice box. In 2023, researchers in Vienna found tiny pads inside cats' vocal folds that let such a small animal hum that low. And when your cat wants breakfast, it slips a high, baby-like cry into the purr. Listeners rate that purr as more urgent. So that rumble isn't only contentment. Sometimes, it's a request.

claims.text: Purrs reach frequencies as low as about 25 Hz.
2023 Vienna study found pads in cat vocal folds enabling low purring frequencies.
Solicitation purrs embed a cry rated as more urgent by listeners.

characters.name: Miso
characters.description: a small round orange tabby cat with a cream-white chest and muzzle, big green eyes, short tail with darker rings, and a teal collar with a small gold bell

scenes.visual_prompt: CHAR_A curled on a cozy sofa cushion, eyes half closed, soft concentric sound-wave rings radiating from its throat; one ring subtly shaped like a tiny crying face
scenes.motion_prompt: slow push-in toward the cat; sound rings pulse outward gently

scenes.visual_prompt: side-view cutaway of CHAR_A sitting upright, its throat shown as a simple see-through window where a small teal voice box glows, wide slow wavy lines flowing out from the throat across the frame; plain warm cream background filling the whole frame
scenes.motion_prompt: gentle pan along the throat; wavy lines ripple slowly

scenes.visual_prompt: a friendly science-lab bench with a big clear glass model of a cat's voice box shaped like a short pink tube; inside it two soft pink curtain-like flaps (the vocal folds), each with a small round coral cushion stuck to it, glowing softly; a magnifying glass on a stand points at the cushions; simple flasks in the background; no people
scenes.motion_prompt: slow push-in through the magnifying glass toward the two coral cushions; the pink flaps flutter gently

scenes.visual_prompt: CHAR_A sitting beside an empty food bowl on a kitchen floor at sunrise, looking up with huge pleading eyes, a thin high zigzag line woven into a thick low wave coming from its mouth
scenes.motion_prompt: camera tilts up from the empty bowl to the cat's face; the zigzag line flickers

scenes.visual_prompt: a human hand (no face visible) pouring kibble into the bowl while CHAR_A rubs against a leg, warm sunrise kitchen, a small speech-bubble-free heart shape above the cat
scenes.motion_prompt: slow lateral pan; kibble falls; the cat's tail swishes
